items.markdown:
[Skingenetix](https://www.skingenetix.com/) is `an Amsterdam-based skincare brand specializing in high-purity, clinically studied peptide and active-ingredient formulas with transparently published concentrations`.[[1]](https://www.skingenetix.com/)[[2]](https://www.ankorstore.com/brand/skingenetix-60587)

### Core Standards & Philosophy

- **Transparent Concentrations:** They publish the exact percentages of key active ingredients on every product page rather than hiding behind proprietary blends.
- **No Fluff Formulas:** Products are formulated without parabens, mineral oil, or added synthetic fragrances.
- **Layering & Routines:** Their streamlined range of serums and creams are designed to layer easily for complete, targeted routines.[[1]](https://www.ankorstore.com/brand/skingenetix-60587)[[2]](https://www.skingenetix.com/)

### Popular Product Range

- **Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Renewal Serum / Creams:** Targets overall skin firmness and renewal.
- **PDRN 1% (Sodium DNA) Range:** Utilizes salmon-derived polynucleotides for a smoother, revitalized complexion (includes a Renewal Serum and Collagen Night Cream).
- **Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum & Creams:** Focuses on firming, smoothing, and deep hydration.
- **Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 Anti-Wrinkle Serum:** Targets the appearance of expression lines.[[1]](https://www.skingenetix.com/collections/all)[[2]](https://www.skingenetix.com/)

If you'd like, let me know:

- Your primary **skin concern** (e.g., fine lines, firmness, hydration)
- Your **skin type** 

I can help recommend a specific Skingenetix product or routine for you.
